description: Connect your Robotomail account to search and read messages, send plain-text email, reply in existing threads, and set a friendly sender name for your agent. Choose an existing mailbox and ask for the email action you need. Sending and replying deliver immediately. A Robotomail account and an existing mailbox are required; your plan and normal usage limits apply.

defaultPrompt: Show my mailboxes and help me set a sender name.
Find recent emails that need a reply and draft responses for me to review.
Help me send an email from one of my mailboxes.
